name: ごはんの種類と量や別添えを指定する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Correct LH19-0007 rice-choice component. Image1 original Chipotle screenshot is highest authority for no-rice circle/slash geometry, fine controls, rice photograph, precise spacing and proportions. Image2 Japanese native mock is secondary content reference. Image3 generated v001 is correction target.
Change only these errors: 「玄米の量」 must use Meiryo REGULAR14/24, not the bold label of v001. Keep quantities/options in established regular Japanese roles. Preserve exact original white rice photograph from image1 (shape, grain arrangement, herb specks, crop and color) rather than generating a new food image.
Keep complete Japanese content: 「ごはん」; 「白米」, 「210 kcal」; 「玄米の量」; four equal unselected options 「通常」「少なめ」「多め」「別添え」; original circle/slash glyph, 「ごはんなし」「0 kcal」. No selected option, no added CTA or green accent, no beans/navigation/other foods. White canvas/card, fine neutral border/dividers, slate supporting glyph, restrained soft shadow, modest rounding. Typography Meiryo, regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0; existing compact bold section/food labels stay as Japanese mock. All text visible.
reviewNotes: 2回目を実見。玄米の量をRegularへ修正、4選択肢の未選択状態・白米210kcal・ごはんなし0kcal・原本の禁止円を維持。白米写真の原本との再描画差は残るため厳密な保持は未受入。2試行の履歴を保存し他へ継続。所有者承認・編集可能性・スワイプや注文連動は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
